name: cc-autocompact
description: Auto-compact for Claude Code when the task ends, not when the context window is full. When the model ends a task with 'Ready to compact.', the mod runs /compact if it pays off, saves the summary and puts the handoff back. From 200k of context it asks the model whether the task is closed; size alone only compacts a window about to overflow (85% full). Adds /compact-now and /cc-doctor.
